source.notes: Allele sequences reconstructed from REF/ALT + GT. Allelic Coverage derived from PDP (fractional read support).
source.allele_designation: Allele calls = reference CE + HipSTR FORMAT GB (bp difference from GRCh38), microvariants as .{remainder_bp}. This equals len(haplotype)//PERIOD once VCF padding bases before the STR region (POS < START) are excluded. genotype_forense lists the two calls in ascending order. Motifs for bracketed display are canonical per locus.

nomenclature.ranges: ISFG minimum range (FSSG v6.1 / ISFG 2024), GRCh38, passed as a BED file with strand '+' because isfg_seq{n} is stored in forward orientation
nomenclature.fields: bracketed{n} = STRNaming name; isfg_seq{n} = exact STRNaming input over the ISFG range; isfgSegments{n} = block colouring from STRNaming --html; isfg_ref5_bp_{n} / isfg_ref3_bp_{n} = reference (not observed) bases at the 5' / 3' end of isfg_seq{n}
nomenclature.verified: 2026-09-27: windows rebuilt from coordinates. The 2026-09-12 build trimmed 1-5 flank bases by sequence similarity in 92/210 alleles and counted VCF padding in 4 calls; both fixed. Checks: the rebuilt windows reproduce the 118 untouched ones exactly; the CE in every name equals reference CE + HipSTR GB (210/210); names fit a STRidER canonical bracketing template in 207/210 (the rest: TH01 9.3 and one rare D18S51 haplotype).
nomenclature.window: isfg_seq{n} = GRCh38[ISFG start .. POS-1] + allele_seq{n} + GRCh38[END+1 .. ISFG end], built from coordinates (GRCh38 no-alt analysis set). The ISFG minimum range extends beyond the HipSTR-genotyped region at every locus, so isfg_ref5_bp_{n} / isfg_ref3_bp_{n} bases at each end are GRCh38 reference, not observed.
